purpose: Source-first census of every top-level named struct and every explicitly named direct field in two frozen Litestream Go files. Compare frozen Compass and Graphify declaration identities before a Compass producer change.
knownDevelopmentGap: The previous hub replay showed zero direct fields for Store and HeartbeatClient; this is a known development sample, not a held-out or random sample.
sourceOracle: Use Go standard-library go/parser and go/ast. Include every top-level TypeSpec whose type is StructType in the two files. For every Field with one or more Names, emit one declaration per name at that identifier's exact 1-based line. Keep embedded fields in a separate unavailable category; never infer a name from the type. Preserve same-line multiple names as separate declarations.
graphJoin: Resolve each struct by exact file, case-sensitive name and declaration start line, with no fallback identity. A direct field declaration match needs an exact case-sensitive field label, exact file and identifier line, a distinct field-compatible node identity, and a stored source-owner-to-target-field contains/defines record. This record-orientation rule also applies to Graphify's undirected graph and does not imply directed traversal. Multiple matching identities or owners are ambiguous. Graphify field-context type-reference edges are recorded separately and cannot substitute for named field declarations. Neither graph receives source-assisted output credit.
report: Retain every source declaration and per-tool exact/ambiguous/missing result, both graph identities and hashes, field-context counts, all unavailable outcomes and limits. Compare both frozen graphs under the same rule. A subsequent Compass candidate must be evaluated separately without changing the frozen denominator.
limitations: The first probe stopped before scoring because it incorrectly required both frozen graphs to have directed=true. Graphify's graph is undirected. The amended join uses stored source/target ownership records only; no candidate outcomes were inspected before this correction.
This is a selected Go development slice from one repository and does not establish general extraction precision or recall.
Declaration coverage does not validate field-access targets, responsibility cohesion, god-object classification, query explanation quality or broad superiority.
The frozen graph producers differ; this comparison does not isolate parser and graph schema effects.
